class Pose: """Discrete pose (CMP--9)."""
def __init__(self, row: int = 0, col: int = 0, heading_idx: int = 0): self.row = row self.col = col # 0:NORTH, 1:EAST, 2:SOUTH, 3:WEST self.heading_idx = heading_idx # Continuous approximations (not strictly required for discrete map) self.x = 0.0 self.y = 0.0 self.theta = 0.0

""" Simple event queue.
Traces: - Event Queue spec from DAT--7 - CMP--1, CMP--11: ExplorationEvents """
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Optional, Any, List
class EventType: EXPLORATION_COMPLETED = "EXPLORATION_COMPLETED" EXPLORATION_TIMEOUT = "EXPLORATION_TIMEOUT" PATH_INVALIDATED = "PATH_INVALIDATED" RETURN_COMPLETED = "RETURN_COMPLETED" SECOND_RUN_COMPLETED = "SECOND_RUN_COMPLETED"
class Event: """DAT--7: struct Event { EventType type; uint32_t timestamp; EventPayload payload; }"""
def __init__(self, ev_type: str, timestamp_ms: int, payload: Any = None): self.type = ev_type self.timestamp_ms = timestamp_ms self.payload = payload
class EventQueue: """Circular buffer of fixed size (DAT--7)."""
def __init__(self, capacity: int = 16): self._capacity = capacity self._buf: List[Optional[Event]] = [None] * capacity self._head = 0 self._tail = 0 self._size = 0
def enqueue(self, ev: Event) -> None: if self._size == self._capacity: # Overwrite oldest event; design does not specify dropping strategy, but # EXPLORATION_COMPLETED / TIMEOUT are emitted only once, so risk is small. self._head = (self._head + 1) % self._capacity self._size -= 1 self._buf[self._tail] = ev self._tail = (self._tail + 1) % self._capacity self._size += 1
def dequeue(self) -> Optional[Event]: if self._size == 0: return None ev = self._buf[self._head] self._buf[self._head] = None self._head = (self._head + 1) % self._capacity self._size -= 1 return ev
def drain(self) -> list: out = [] while True: ev = self.dequeue() if ev is None: break out.append(ev) return out

""" Frontier Generation and Exploration Target Selection.
Traces: - CMP--2 implementation - DAT--3 (time-aware planning) """
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import List, Optional, Tuple
from . import config from .grid_map import GridMap, CellIndex from .types import CellState
class FrontierTarget: """Represents FGM_SelectedTarget (CMP--2)."""
def __init__(self, cell: Optional[CellIndex], est_travel_ms: int = 0): self.cell = cell self.estimated_travel_ms = est_travel_ms self.estimated_info_gain = 0 self.heuristic_value = 0.0
class FrontierGenerator: """CMP--2 implementation."""
def __init__(self, grid: GridMap): self.grid = grid self._cached_frontiers: List[CellIndex] = [] self._cache_valid = False
# ==== Frontier recomputation (CMP--2, Execution) =======================
def recompute_frontiers(self) -> List[CellIndex]: """Compute set of frontier cells.
Frontier = UNKNOWN cells that have at least one FREE 4-neighbor. """ rows = self.grid.rows cols = self.grid.cols res: List[CellIndex] = [] for r in range(rows): for c in range(cols): if self.grid.get_cell_state(r, c) != CellState.CELL_UNKNOWN: continue # Check for FREE neighbor for nr, nc in self.grid.neighbors4(r, c): if self.grid.get_cell_state(nr, nc) == CellState.CELL_FREE: res.append((r, c)) break self._cached_frontiers = res self._cache_valid = True return res
def invalidate_cache(self) -> None: self._cache_valid = False
def get_frontiers(self) -> List[CellIndex]: if not self._cache_valid: return self.recompute_frontiers() return list(self._cached_frontiers)
# ==== Target selection (CMP--2) ========================================
def select_target( self, current_cell: CellIndex, remaining_time_ms: int, nominal_cell_traversal_ms: int = config.NOMINAL_CELL_TRAVERSAL_MS, ) -> FrontierTarget: """Select best feasible frontier cell.
Very simple heuristic: - Use Manhattan distance as approximate path length. - Check time feasibility per DAT--3. - Choose closest feasible candidate. """ frontiers = self.get_frontiers() if not frontiers: return FrontierTarget(None)
best: Optional[Tuple[CellIndex, int]] = None
for fr in frontiers: d_cells = abs(fr[0] - current_cell[0]) + abs(fr[1] - current_cell[1]) est_travel = d_cells * nominal_cell_traversal_ms est_mapping_overhead = nominal_cell_traversal_ms
if est_travel + est_mapping_overhead > remaining_time_ms: # Time-aware planning filter (DAT--3) continue
if best is None or est_travel < best[1]: best = (fr, est_travel)
if best is None: # No feasible candidates (CMP--2 Failures: Time-limit constraint) return FrontierTarget(None)
tgt = FrontierTarget(best[0], best[1]) tgt.heuristic_value = 1.0 / (1.0 + best[1]) return tgt

""" Path Planner implementation.
Traces: - CMP--4 Path Planner - DAT--2 cost model """
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Dict, Tuple, List, Optional import math
from .grid_map import GridMap, CellIndex from .types import PlanningStatus from . import config
class PathPlanningRequest: """Simplified MC_PathPlanningRequest (CMP--1, CMP--4)."""
def __init__(self, request_id: int, mode: str, start: CellIndex, goals: List[CellIndex]): self.request_id = request_id self.mode = mode # "EXPLORE", "RETURN_TO_START", "SECOND_RUN" self.start = start self.goals = goals
class PathPlanningResponse: """PL_PathPlanningResponse (CMP--4)."""
def __init__(self, request: PathPlanningRequest): self.request_id = request.request_id self.status: str = PlanningStatus.FAILURE_NO_PATH self.path: List[CellIndex] = [] self.total_cost: float = 0.0 self.estimated_time_ms: int = 0
class Planner: """Dijkstra / A* over grid (CMP--4)."""
def __init__(self, grid: GridMap): self.grid = grid
def plan(self, req: PathPlanningRequest) -> PathPlanningResponse: """Plan path according to CMP--4 Execution (Dijkstra/A*).""" resp = PathPlanningResponse(req) if not req.goals: resp.status = PlanningStatus.INVALID_GOAL return resp
# Single-mode: we use Dijkstra with uniform cell cost and optional turn penalty. # For simplicity we treat all edges same, plus a small turn penalty. start = req.start goals = set(req.goals)
# Basic Dijkstra over up to 32 cells. dist: Dict[CellIndex, float] = {} prev: Dict[CellIndex, Tuple[CellIndex, int]] = {} # cell -> (prev_cell, heading_idx) visited: Dict[CellIndex, bool] = {} frontier: List[Tuple[float, CellIndex, int]] = [] # (cost, cell, heading)
# Start with all 4 headings possible; choose 0 with 0 cost. start_heading = 0 dist[start] = 0.0 prev[start] = (start, start_heading) frontier.append((0.0, start, start_heading))
def pop_min() -> Optional[Tuple[float, CellIndex, int]]: if not frontier: return None # O(N) scan is fine for 32 cells. best_i = 0 best_val = frontier[0][0] for i, (c, _, _) in enumerate(frontier): if c < best_val: best_val = c best_i = i return frontier.pop(best_i)
goal_reached: Optional[CellIndex] = None goal_heading = 0
while True: node = pop_min() if node is None: break cost, cell, heading = node if visited.get(cell): continue visited[cell] = True
if cell in goals: goal_reached = cell goal_heading = heading break
# Expand neighbors r, c = cell for (nr, nc) in self.grid.neighbors4(r, c): if not self.grid.is_edge_traversable((r, c), (nr, nc)): continue # Determine new heading dr = nr - r dc = nc - c if dr == -1: new_heading = 0 # N elif dc == 1: new_heading = 1 # E elif dr == 1: new_heading = 2 # S else: new_heading = 3 # W
edge_cost = config.BASE_STRAIGHT_COST if new_heading != heading: edge_cost += config.TURN_PENALTY
new_cost = cost + edge_cost old = dist.get((nr, nc)) if old is None or new_cost < old: dist[(nr, nc)] = new_cost prev[(nr, nc)] = (cell, new_heading) frontier.append((new_cost, (nr, nc), new_heading))
if goal_reached is None: resp.status = PlanningStatus.FAILURE_NO_PATH return resp
# Reconstruct path path: List[CellIndex] = [] cur = goal_reached cur_heading = goal_heading while True: path.append(cur) p_cell, p_heading = prev[cur] if p_cell == cur: break cur = p_cell cur_heading = p_heading path.reverse() resp.path = path resp.total_cost = dist[goal_reached]
# Map cost to time estimate; we simply scale by NOMINAL_CELL_TRAVERSAL_MS. straight_cells = len(path) - 1 resp.estimated_time_ms = int(straight_cells * config.NOMINAL_CELL_TRAVERSAL_MS) resp.status = PlanningStatus.SUCCESS return resp

""" Goal Region Identification and Selection.
Traces: - CMP--5 Goal Region Identification and Selection """
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import List, Tuple, Optional
from .grid_map import GridMap, CellIndex from .planner import Planner, PathPlanningRequest from .types import CellState, PlanningStatus
class GoalRegionSelector: """CMP--5 implementation."""
def __init__(self, grid: GridMap, planner: Planner): self.grid = grid self.planner = planner self.selected_region: Optional[List[CellIndex]] = None self.selected_goal_cell: Optional[CellIndex] = None
def _enumerate_candidate_regions(self) -> List[List[CellIndex]]: """Enumerate all 2x2 all-FREE regions (CMP--5 Execution step 2).""" regions: List[List[CellIndex]] = [] for r in range(self.grid.rows - 1): for c in range(self.grid.cols - 1): cells = [(r, c), (r + 1, c), (r, c + 1), (r + 1, c + 1)] if all(self.grid.get_cell_state(cr, cc) == CellState.CELL_FREE for cr, cc in cells): regions.append(cells) return regions
def select_region(self) -> None: """Perform full goal region selection once (CMP--5 Execution).""" start = self.grid.start_cell candidates = self._enumerate_candidate_regions() best_region: Optional[List[CellIndex]] = None best_cost: Optional[float] = None best_goal: Optional[CellIndex] = None
for region in candidates: # Request cost info (CMP--5 Execution step 3). # We'll pick minimal cost among cells in region. region_best_cost: Optional[float] = None region_best_cell: Optional[CellIndex] = None
for cell in region: req = PathPlanningRequest(request_id=0, mode="SECOND_RUN", start=start, goals=[cell]) resp = self.planner.plan(req) if resp.status != PlanningStatus.SUCCESS: continue if region_best_cost is None or resp.total_cost < region_best_cost: region_best_cost = resp.total_cost region_best_cell = cell
if region_best_cost is None: # Region unreachable continue
if best_cost is None or region_best_cost < best_cost: best_cost = region_best_cost best_region = region best_goal = region_best_cell
self.selected_region = best_region self.selected_goal_cell = best_goal

""" Sensor Abstraction and Filtering Layer.
Traces: - CMP--7 Sensor Abstraction and Filtering Layer - DAT--5 Sensor Filtering and Consistency Parameters """
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import List
from waveshare.ultrasonic_sensor import UltrasonicSensor from waveshare.infrared import Infrared
from . import config from .utils import moving_average, bool_majority
class FilteredSensorData: """SAL_FilteredSensorData (CMP--7, CMP--6, CMP--8)."""
def __init__(self): self.ultrasonic_cm: float = 1000.0 self.ultrasonic_valid: bool = False self.ir_left: bool = False self.ir_right: bool = False self.timestamp_ms: int = 0
class SensorLayer: """Implementation of CMP--7."""
def __init__(self, time_ms_provider): self._time_ms = time_ms_provider
self._ultra = UltrasonicSensor() self._ir = Infrared()
self._ultra_buf: List[float] = [] self._ir_left_buf: List[bool] = [] self._ir_right_buf: List[bool] = []
self.filtered = FilteredSensorData()
self.sensor_available: bool = False # SensorAvailabilityStatus
self._ultra_seen_valid = False self._ir_seen_valid = False
def _read_ultrasonic_raw(self) -> float: try: d = float(self._ultra.distance()) except Exception: return -1.0 return d
def _read_ir_raw(self): try: left = bool(self._ir.dsl()) right = bool(self._ir.dsr()) except Exception: left = False right = False return left, right
def update(self) -> None: """Execute one SAL update per control loop (CMP--7 Execution).""" now = self._time_ms()
# 1) Sample raw sensors raw_d = self._read_ultrasonic_raw() raw_left, raw_right = self._read_ir_raw()
# 2) Sanitize invalid ultrasonic values (CMP--7 Execution step 2) if raw_d <= 0 or raw_d != raw_d: # NaN check ultra_valid = False raw_d = 1000.0 else: ultra_valid = True
self._ultra_buf.append(raw_d) if len(self._ultra_buf) > config.ULTRASONIC_WINDOW: self._ultra_buf.pop(0)
self._ir_left_buf.append(raw_left) if len(self._ir_left_buf) > config.IR_WINDOW: self._ir_left_buf.pop(0)
self._ir_right_buf.append(raw_right) if len(self._ir_right_buf) > config.IR_WINDOW: self._ir_right_buf.pop(0)
# 3) Compute filtered values (moving average / majority) filt_d = moving_average(self._ultra_buf) filt_left = bool_majority(self._ir_left_buf) filt_right = bool_majority(self._ir_right_buf)
self.filtered.ultrasonic_cm = filt_d self.filtered.ultrasonic_valid = ultra_valid self.filtered.ir_left = filt_left self.filtered.ir_right = filt_right self.filtered.timestamp_ms = now
# 5) Update SensorAvailabilityStatus (CMP--7 Execution step 5) if ultra_valid: self._ultra_seen_valid = True if True: # IR "valid" is always; we just treat as data self._ir_seen_valid = True
self.sensor_available = self._ultra_seen_valid and self._ir_seen_valid

""" Mapping and Wall Detection Module.
Traces: - CMP--6 Mapping and Wall Detection Module - Uses SAL_FilteredSensorData (CMP--7) and GridMap (CMP--3) """
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Dict, Tuple
from .grid_map import GridMap, CellIndex from .sensor_layer import FilteredSensorData from .types import CellState, WallState from . import config
class MappingModule: """CMP--6 implementation (simplified but respecting invariants)."""
def __init__(self, grid: GridMap): self.grid = grid
# Hysteresis / consistency counters per cell or wall index (DAT--5). # For simplicity, we track cell free & blocked evidence. self._cell_free_evidence: Dict[CellIndex, int] = {} self._cell_blocked_evidence: Dict[CellIndex, int] = {}
# ==== Helpers ==========================================================
def _inc_counter(self, d: Dict[CellIndex, int], key: CellIndex) -> int: v = d.get(key, 0) + 1 d[key] = v return v
# ==== Main per-loop update (CMP--6 Execution) ==========================
def update_for_pose_and_sensors( self, pose_cell: CellIndex, pose_heading_idx: int, at_cell_center: bool, filtered: FilteredSensorData, ) -> None: """Per control loop mapping logic.
This implementation focuses on free cell confirmation and very coarse front-wall detection. Full geometric wall indexing is simplified for MicroPython, but invariants from CMP--6 and CMP--3 are respected. """ r, c = pose_cell
# === 2) Front wall detection via ultrasonic ======================== # Very simple rule: if at cell center and ultrasonic is below some # threshold, we infer a wall in front direction, and optionally infer # neighbor cell as BLOCKED (CMP--6 Execution step 2, 5). if at_cell_center and filtered.ultrasonic_valid: d = filtered.ultrasonic_cm # Use expected approx center-to-wall distance (DAT--4). approx_front_dist = config.CELL_LENGTH_CM / 2.0 # If reading is within uncertainty band of front wall, mark wall present. if d < approx_front_dist + config.ULTRASONIC_UNCERTAINTY_CM: nr, nc = self._neighbor_in_heading(r, c, pose_heading_idx) if nr is not None: # Mark neighbor as BLOCKED via UNKNOWN->BLOCKED rule (CMP--3 Invariants) if self.grid.get_cell_state(nr, nc) == CellState.CELL_UNKNOWN: cnt = self._inc_counter(self._cell_blocked_evidence, (nr, nc)) if cnt >= config.CONSISTENCY_N: self.grid.set_cell_state_unknown_to(nr, nc, CellState.CELL_BLOCKED)
# === 3) Free cell confirmation on being at center ================== # If we are at cell center, mark current cell as FREE after enough # consistent occupancy with no collision; collision info is not modeled # explicitly here but can be threaded in. if at_cell_center: if self.grid.get_cell_state(r, c) == CellState.CELL_UNKNOWN: cnt = self._inc_counter(self._cell_free_evidence, (r, c)) if cnt >= config.CONSISTENCY_N: self.grid.set_cell_state_unknown_to(r, c, CellState.CELL_FREE)
# ==== Simple helper to get neighbor in heading =========================
def _neighbor_in_heading(self, r: int, c: int, heading_idx: int) -> Tuple[int, int]: # 0:N, 1:E, 2:S, 3:W if heading_idx == 0 and r > 0: return r - 1, c if heading_idx == 2 and r < self.grid.rows - 1: return r + 1, c if heading_idx == 1 and c < self.grid.cols - 1: return r, c + 1 if heading_idx == 3 and c > 0: return r, c - 1 return None, None

""" Motion Control and Collision Avoidance.
Traces: - CMP--8 Motion Control and Collision Avoidance - DAT--6 Motion Primitive Specification """
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import List, Optional
from waveshare.motor import Motor
from . import config from .grid_map import CellIndex from .sensor_layer import FilteredSensorData from .types import PathExecutionStatus from .utils import clamp
class MotionCommand: """High-level motion command from Mission Control (MC_MotionCommand, CMP--1/8)."""
def __init__(self, path: List[CellIndex], speed_profile: str): self.path = path self.speed_profile = speed_profile # "EXPLORE", "RETURN", "SECOND_RUN"
class MotionController: """CMP--8 implementation (simplified)."""
def __init__(self, motor: Motor): self.motor = motor
self._mode = "NORMAL" # NORMAL / AVOIDANCE / EMERGENCY_STOPPED self._current_cmd: Optional[MotionCommand] = None
self._path_index = 0 # next waypoint index self._left_speed = 0 self._right_speed = 0
self.path_status: str = PathExecutionStatus.RUNNING
# ==== Command handling =================================================
def set_motion_command(self, cmd: MotionCommand) -> None: """Accept new high-level motion command (CMP--8 Execution).""" self._current_cmd = cmd self._mode = "NORMAL" self._path_index = 0 self.path_status = PathExecutionStatus.RUNNING
# ==== Per-loop update ==================================================
def update(self, filtered: FilteredSensorData, current_cell: CellIndex) -> None: """Per control-loop update (CMP--8 Execution).""" # 1) Emergency-stop check if self._mode != "EMERGENCY_STOPPED": if filtered.ultrasonic_valid and filtered.ultrasonic_cm < config.EMERGENCY_STOP_THRESHOLD_CM: # Emergency stop (CMP--8 Failures) self._left_speed = 0 self._right_speed = 0 self.motor.stop() self._mode = "EMERGENCY_STOPPED" self.path_status = PathExecutionStatus.COLLISION_ABORTED return
# If emergency stopped, remain so until new command is set. if self._mode == "EMERGENCY_STOPPED": self.motor.stop() return
# 4) Execute simple cell-center primitive following path if not self._current_cmd or not self._current_cmd.path: # Nothing to do self._set_speeds(0, 0) return
# Check if we reached last waypoint if self._path_index >= len(self._current_cmd.path): self._set_speeds(0, 0) self.path_status = PathExecutionStatus.SUCCESS_REACHED_GOAL return
target_cell = self._current_cmd.path[self._path_index] if current_cell == target_cell: # Advance to next waypoint self._path_index += 1 if self._path_index >= len(self._current_cmd.path): self._set_speeds(0, 0) self.path_status = PathExecutionStatus.SUCCESS_REACHED_GOAL return target_cell = self._current_cmd.path[self._path_index]
# For this simple example, we approximate: always move forward with # given speed profile; pose estimator is updated externally. duty = self._profile_to_speed(self._current_cmd.speed_profile) self._set_speeds(duty, duty)
# ==== Internal helpers =================================================
def _profile_to_speed(self, profile: str) -> int: if profile == "SECOND_RUN": return config.SECOND_RUN_SPEED_DUTY if profile == "RETURN": return config.RETURN_SPEED_DUTY return config.EXPLORATION_SPEED_DUTY
def _set_speeds(self, left: int, right: int) -> None: # Rate limiting per CMP--8 Invariants. left = int(clamp(left, -config.MAX_SPEED_DUTY, config.MAX_SPEED_DUTY)) right = int(clamp(right, -config.MAX_SPEED_DUTY, config.MAX_SPEED_DUTY))
dl = left - self._left_speed dr = right - self._right_speed if abs(dl) > config.MAX_ACCEL_PER_CYCLE: left = self._left_speed + config.MAX_ACCEL_PER_CYCLE * (1 if dl > 0 else -1) if abs(dr) > config.MAX_ACCEL_PER_CYCLE: right = self._right_speed + config.MAX_ACCEL_PER_CYCLE * (1 if dr > 0 else -1)
self._left_speed = left self._right_speed = right self.motor.set(left, right)

""" Exploration Status and Time Limit Module.

from __future__ import annotations
from . import config from .grid_map import GridMap from .events import EventQueue, Event, EventType
class ExplorationStatus: """CMP--11 implementation."""
def __init__(self, grid: GridMap, event_queue: EventQueue, time_ms_provider): self.grid = grid self.events = event_queue self._time_ms = time_ms_provider
self._explore_start_ms: int = 0 self._timeout_emitted = False self._completed_emitted = False
self.elapsed_ms: int = 0 self.remaining_ms: int = config.EXPLORATION_TIME_LIMIT_MS
def start_exploration(self) -> None: self._explore_start_ms = self._time_ms() self._timeout_emitted = False self._completed_emitted = False
def update(self) -> None: """Each control loop (CMP--11 Execution).""" if self._explore_start_ms == 0: return
now = self._time_ms() self.elapsed_ms = now - self._explore_start_ms if self.elapsed_ms < 0: self.elapsed_ms = 0 self.remaining_ms = config.EXPLORATION_TIME_LIMIT_MS - self.elapsed_ms if self.remaining_ms < 0: self.remaining_ms = 0
# 2) Timeout if not self._timeout_emitted and self.elapsed_ms >= config.EXPLORATION_TIME_LIMIT_MS: self._timeout_emitted = True self.events.enqueue(Event(EventType.EXPLORATION_TIMEOUT, now))
# 3) Map completeness if not self._completed_emitted and self.grid.map_complete: self._completed_emitted = True self.events.enqueue(Event(EventType.EXPLORATION_COMPLETED, now))

""" Mission Control State Machine (CMP--1, FSM--1). """
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Optional, List
from .types import MissionState, SecondRunStatusEnum, PathExecutionStatus, PlanningStatus from .events import EventQueue, EventType, Event from .grid_map import GridMap, CellIndex from .frontier import FrontierGenerator, FrontierTarget from .planner import Planner, PathPlanningRequest from .goal_region import GoalRegionSelector from .exploration_status import ExplorationStatus from .motion_control import MotionCommand, MotionController from .sensor_layer import SensorLayer from .pose import PoseEstimator from . import config
class MissionControl: """Implementation of CMP--1 and FSM--1."""
def __init__( self, grid: GridMap, frontier: FrontierGenerator, planner: Planner, goal_region: GoalRegionSelector, exploration_status: ExplorationStatus, motion: MotionController, pose: PoseEstimator, sensors: SensorLayer, events: EventQueue, time_ms_provider, ): self.grid = grid self.frontier = frontier self.planner = planner self.goal_region = goal_region self.expl_status = exploration_status self.motion = motion self.pose = pose self.sensors = sensors self.events = events self._time_ms = time_ms_provider
self.state: str = MissionState.IDLE self.second_run_status: int = SecondRunStatusEnum.SECOND_RUN_NOT_EXECUTED
self._init_completed: bool = False # from scheduler self._have_goal_region: bool = False
# ===== External control flags =========================================
def set_init_completed(self) -> None: self._init_completed = True
# ===== Per-loop update =================================================
def update(self) -> None: """One iteration of mission logic per control loop (CMP--1 Execution).""" # Drain relevant events events = self.events.drain()
if self.state == MissionState.IDLE: self._state_idle(events) elif self.state == MissionState.EXPLORE: self._state_explore(events) elif self.state == MissionState.RETURN_TO_START: self._state_return_to_start(events) elif self.state == MissionState.SECOND_RUN: self._state_second_run(events) elif self.state == MissionState.COMPLETED: self._state_completed(events)
# ===== State handlers (FSM--1) ========================================
def _state_idle(self, events: list) -> None: # FSM--1 IDLE state action: keep motors stopped, monitor INIT_COMPLETED & SensorAvailabilityStatus. self.motion.set_motion_command(MotionCommand([], "EXPLORE")) # results in stop # Check transition IDLE -> EXPLORE (FSM--1) if self._init_completed and self.sensors.sensor_available: # TransitionAction: start exploration timers/modules. self.expl_status.start_exploration() self.state = MissionState.EXPLORE
def _state_explore(self, events: list) -> None: # Process exploration events to decide transition to RETURN_TO_START. exploration_completed = False exploration_timeout = False for ev in events: if ev.type == EventType.EXPLORATION_COMPLETED: exploration_completed = True elif ev.type == EventType.EXPLORATION_TIMEOUT: exploration_timeout = True
if exploration_completed or exploration_timeout: # Transition EXPLORE->RETURN_TO_START (FSM--1). self.state = MissionState.RETURN_TO_START return
# StateAction (FSM--1): frontier selection + path planning + motion command. current_cell: CellIndex = self.pose.pose.cell() remaining_ms = self.expl_status.remaining_ms target: FrontierTarget = self.frontier.select_target(current_cell, remaining_ms) if target.cell is None: # No frontier; rely on EXPLORATION_COMPLETED event. self.motion.set_motion_command(MotionCommand([], "EXPLORE")) return
# Path planning request req = PathPlanningRequest( request_id=1, mode="EXPLORE", start=current_cell, goals=[target.cell], ) resp = self.planner.plan(req) if resp.status != PlanningStatus.SUCCESS or not resp.path: # No path; rely on exploration status / timeout events. self.motion.set_motion_command(MotionCommand([], "EXPLORE")) return
# Issue motion command (CMP--1 Purpose, MC_MotionCommand) cmd = MotionCommand(resp.path, "EXPLORE") self.motion.set_motion_command(cmd)
def _state_return_to_start(self, events: list) -> None: # On entry, if path not yet started, request path to start. # For simplicity, we check if motion has no command or already completed. if self.motion.path_status in ( PathExecutionStatus.SUCCESS_REACHED_GOAL, PathExecutionStatus.COLLISION_ABORTED, PathExecutionStatus.FAILURE_NO_PATH, ) or not self.motion._current_cmd: current_cell: CellIndex = self.pose.pose.cell() start_cell = self.grid.start_cell req = PathPlanningRequest( request_id=2, mode="RETURN_TO_START", start=current_cell, goals=[start_cell] ) resp = self.planner.plan(req) if resp.status != PlanningStatus.SUCCESS or not resp.path: # Planning failure in RETURN_TO_START (CMP--1 Failures) self.state = MissionState.COMPLETED self.second_run_status = SecondRunStatusEnum.SECOND_RUN_FAILURE return cmd = MotionCommand(resp.path, "RETURN") self.motion.set_motion_command(cmd)
# Monitor path execution status if self.motion.path_status == PathExecutionStatus.SUCCESS_REACHED_GOAL: # Evaluate whether we can do second run # Select goal region if not done if not self._have_goal_region: self.goal_region.select_region() self._have_goal_region = self.goal_region.selected_region is not None if self._have_goal_region: self.state = MissionState.SECOND_RUN self.second_run_status = SecondRunStatusEnum.SECOND_RUN_NOT_EXECUTED else: # No goal region found; mission completed self.state = MissionState.COMPLETED self.second_run_status = SecondRunStatusEnum.SECOND_RUN_FAILURE
elif self.motion.path_status == PathExecutionStatus.COLLISION_ABORTED: # RETURN_TO_START failure => mission ends (CMP--1 Failures) self.state = MissionState.COMPLETED self.second_run_status = SecondRunStatusEnum.SECOND_RUN_FAILURE
def _state_second_run(self, events: list) -> None: # On entry or when command completes, plan fastest path to goal region if ( self.motion.path_status in ( PathExecutionStatus.SUCCESS_REACHED_GOAL, PathExecutionStatus.COLLISION_ABORTED, PathExecutionStatus.FAILURE_NO_PATH, ) or not self.motion._current_cmd ): if not self._have_goal_region or self.goal_region.selected_goal_cell is None: self.state = MissionState.COMPLETED self.second_run_status = SecondRunStatusEnum.SECOND_RUN_FAILURE return
start_cell = self.grid.start_cell goal_cell = self.goal_region.selected_goal_cell req = PathPlanningRequest( request_id=3, mode="SECOND_RUN", start=start_cell, goals=[goal_cell], ) resp = self.planner.plan(req) if resp.status != PlanningStatus.SUCCESS or not resp.path: self.state = MissionState.COMPLETED self.second_run_status = SecondRunStatusEnum.SECOND_RUN_FAILURE return cmd = MotionCommand(resp.path, "SECOND_RUN") self.motion.set_motion_command(cmd) self.second_run_status = SecondRunStatusEnum.SECOND_RUN_NOT_EXECUTED
# Monitor path execution if self.motion.path_status == PathExecutionStatus.SUCCESS_REACHED_GOAL: self.state = MissionState.COMPLETED self.second_run_status = SecondRunStatusEnum.SECOND_RUN_SUCCESS elif self.motion.path_status == PathExecutionStatus.COLLISION_ABORTED: self.state = MissionState.COMPLETED self.second_run_status = SecondRunStatusEnum.SECOND_RUN_FAILURE
def _state_completed(self, events: list) -> None: # COMPLETED: cease issuing new commands (FSM--1). self.motion.set_motion_command(MotionCommand([], "EXPLORE")) # Mission remains in this state; status latched in self.second_run_status. return

from __future__ import annotations
import time
from waveshare.motor import Motor
from . import config from .grid_map import GridMap from .frontier import FrontierGenerator from .planner import Planner from .goal_region import GoalRegionSelector from .sensor_layer import SensorLayer from .mapping import MappingModule from .pose import PoseEstimator from .motion_control import MotionController from .exploration_status import ExplorationStatus from .events import EventQueue from .mission_control import MissionControl
class Scheduler: """CMP--10 implementation with a blocking main loop."""
def __init__(self): self._start_time = time.ticks_ms()
self.grid = GridMap() self.grid.init_request(start_cell=(0, 0))
self.event_queue = EventQueue()
self.pose = PoseEstimator() self.motor = Motor() self.motion = MotionController(self.motor)
self.sensors = SensorLayer(self.time_ms) self.mapping = MappingModule(self.grid) self.frontier = FrontierGenerator(self.grid) self.planner = Planner(self.grid) self.goal_region = GoalRegionSelector(self.grid, self.planner) self.expl_status = ExplorationStatus(self.grid, self.event_queue, self.time_ms)
self.mission = MissionControl( grid=self.grid, frontier=self.frontier, planner=self.planner, goal_region=self.goal_region, exploration_status=self.expl_status, motion=self.motion, pose=self.pose, sensors=self.sensors, events=self.event_queue, time_ms_provider=self.time_ms, )
# After initialization, raise INIT_COMPLETED self.mission.set_init_completed()
def time_ms(self) -> int: return time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), self._start_time)
def run(self) -> None: """Blocking control loop; called from main.py.""" period_ms = int(config.CONTROL_PERIOD_MS) while True: loop_start = time.ticks_ms()
# 1) Scheduler tick is implicit here (CMP--10 Execution). # 2) Acquire sensor readings self.sensors.update()
# 3) Update mapping and grid map self.mapping.update_for_pose_and_sensors( pose_cell=self.pose.pose.cell(), pose_heading_idx=self.pose.pose.heading_idx, at_cell_center=self.pose.at_cell_center, filtered=self.sensors.filtered, )
# 4) Exploration status self.expl_status.update()
# 5) Mission control self.mission.update()
# 6) Motion control self.motion.update(self.sensors.filtered, self.pose.pose.cell())
# Sleep to maintain control period elapsed = time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), loop_start) remaining = period_ms - elapsed if remaining > 0: time.sleep_ms(remaining)
